Classic Beef Lasagna

A Sunday dinner favourite. Serves 8.

Ingredients

For the meat sauce:
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 lb ground beef
1 (28 oz) can crushed tomatoes
2 cloves garlic, minced
Salt and pepper, to taste

For the cheese filling:
15 oz ricotta
1 egg
1/2 cup grated Parmesan

Assembly
12 lasagna noodles, cooked
3 cups shredded mozzarella

Directions

For the meat sauce:
1. Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Brown the beef,
breaking it up, about 8 minutes.
2. Add garlic and tomatoes. Simmer 30 minutes. Season.

For the cheese filling:
1. Stir together ricotta, egg and Parmesan.

Assembly:
1. Heat the oven to 375F.
2. Layer noodles, sauce, filling and mozzarella. Repeat.
3. Bake 45 minutes, until bubbling.

Notes:
Freezes well for up to 3 months.
